_about: The home hero's phone gallery, "Cape Town Memories" (HeroPhoneGallery, src/partials/phone-gallery.mjs): six real days out with Good Times guests, each with its image slot (src/data/images.mjs, where the alt text and the origin live), a short place caption and the Good Times tour the moment belongs to (src/data/tours.mjs). Chosen in the media audit of 6 Nov 2026 from the owner's Drive library, at the owner's direction that the memories be authentic: they replace the six AI-generated pictures of the café scene's friends (549–828 px wide) supplied on 5 Nov 2026. None of them appears anywhere else on the site (audit/image-change-register.md).
title: Cape Town Memories
